gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Encoding an all-digit string yields an empty result, because the input contains no letters that map to a Soundex code.
ADDED i3: difference() returns 0 when one of the inputs is null, indicating no similarity could be computed.
ADDED i4: getMappingCode() returns the null character ('�') when the custom mapping is too short to contain an entry for the requested letter's position.
ADDED i5: Encoding a non-String object throws an exception, since the encode(Object) contract only accepts String inputs.
ADDED i7: difference() returns 1 when two identical strings are encoded with a custom mapping that collapses them to a single shared code character.
ADDED i8: A RefinedSoundex instance can be constructed from an arbitrary mapping string without error.
